# BikroyNow.com

> BikroyNow.com is Bangladesh's trusted online marketplace to buy and sell used mobiles, laptops, routers, bikes, and electronics safely and fast across all 64 districts.

## Overview
- **Website:** https://www.bikroynow.com
- **Business Name:** BikroyNow.com
- **Location:** Nagarpur, Tangail, Bangladesh
- **Languages:** English, Bengali (বাংলা)
- **Support Email:** support@bikroynow.com
- **Helpline:** +880 9612-488488

## Main Marketplace Categories
- **Electronics:** Consumer electronics, accessories, TVs, audio systems, and home appliances.
- **Routers & Networking:** Wi-Fi routers, dual-band routers, ONUs, mini UPS devices, and networking gear.
- **Mobiles:** Used and brand-new smartphones, feature phones, tablets, and mobile accessories.
- **Laptops:** Second-hand and new laptops, desktops, monitors, and computer components.
- **Vehicles:** Used motorcycles, cars, bicycles, and commercial vehicles across Bangladesh.
- **Property:** Apartments, houses, land, and commercial spaces for rent or sale.

- [Membership Packages](https://www.bikroynow.com/membership): Business Member, Gold, Silver, and ad promotion packages.
- [About Us](https://www.bikroynow.com/about-us): Learn about BikroyNow.com, ad promotions, and marketplace features.
- [FAQ](https://www.bikroynow.com/faq): Frequently asked questions on buying, selling, and account safety.
- [Contact Us](https://www.bikroynow.com/contact): Reach BikroyNow customer support via email, helpline, or social media.
- [Stay Safe](https://www.bikroynow.com/stay-safe): Buyer and seller safety guidelines for local meetups and transactions.
- [Sell Fast](https://www.bikroynow.com/sell-fast): Tips and tools for selling items quickly on BikroyNow.com.
